subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Correcting information is not about looking smarter.”?
options: It is about keeping a community from being misled.
It is also about what happens along the way.
It is also about protecting someone's dignity while giving.
It was about learning why the trash was there.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Correcting information is not about looking smarter. It is about keeping a community from being misled.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about what happens along the way.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about protecting someone's dignity while giving.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It was about learning why the trash was there.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Correcting information is not about looking smarter. It is about keeping a community from being misled.」，答案為「It is about keeping a community from being misled.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is about keeping a community from being misled.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
